svg.text: V4 landmark import & tuning — independent observation review
Read-only monitoring of the Codex agent run, 2026-09-15 01:04–07:15 · four buildings: Dadongmen, Guidemen, Wuxianmen, Zhengximen

g.text: blocking failure (corrected mid-run)
quality / correctness left in result
evidence / measurement integrity
operational / hygiene
Observed pipeline
Prepare
extract · hash · repair
Import glTF/GLB
3 of 4 buildings
Import FBX
Zhengximen · failed
Wrap Blueprint
one actor per gate
Finalize facing
blanket two-sided
Validate
editor + commandlet
Tune + archive
4 passes
Issues recorded
B1 · Silent zero-mesh FBX import
Interchange returned no meshes and no error for the
package ASCII FBX. Only a hand-written assertion caught it.
Fix applied two changes at once (FBX text repair +
Interchange.FeatureFlags.Import.FBX 0 + FbxFactory), so the
real root cause was never isolated.
B2 · Clean .glb sibling ignored
Zhengximen ships SM_Zhengximen_LOD0.glb (4.6 MB) beside
the 22.5 MB ASCII FBX. GLB imports cleanly through the same
path the other three gates used, yet the config pins the FBX.
The whole failure class was avoidable by source choice.
B3 · Guard widened, then narrowed to pass
The tuned-material assertion first covered every mesh. After
it failed on LOD1–LOD3 it was narrowed to the primary LOD,
so those LODs still bind untuned materials and nothing tests
them. Archives call this "strengthened validation".
Q1 · Blanket two-sided on 84 assets
FinalizeV4BuildingMaterials sets two_sided on every material
and double_sided_geometry on every mesh of Guidemen and
Zhengximen — including LOD1–LOD4 and UCX collision meshes.
The project's own skill documents two-sided as a stopgap that
belongs in the 3D pipeline; here it disables back-face culling
across two entire landmarks.
Q2 · Collision meshes imported, never used
create_blueprint hardcodes collision = False and skips every
non-primary source, so the Collision_* branch is dead code.
Every UCX_* mesh is imported, material-bound and saved but
never attached — collision_components is 0 for all four gates.
Meanwhile the primary Nanite mesh carries
CTF_USE_COMPLEX_AS_SIMPLE, so physics uses the full
Q3 · Duplicate textures not consolidated
Byte-identical 4K maps ship under different material names and
each becomes its own Texture2D asset:
Wuxianmen 6× *_Metallic_4K · Zhengximen 7× *_Metallic
Guidemen 4× *_Metallic · Dadongmen 3× *_M_4K
Also: M_Dadongmen_Vegetation has no texture maps at all and
falls back to a flat constant colour.
E1 · Validation is not reproducible
Same script, same assets, two processes — different heights:
Dadongmen 2248.0 (editor) vs 2138.5 (commandlet) — 1.10 m apart
Guidemen 1690.7 vs 1562.7 · Wuxianmen 1900.3 vs 1888.4
Zhengximen 1781.7 vs 1689.7
Both runs are recorded PASS and cited as equivalent evidence.
The orientation guard 1200 < size[2] < 3000 accepts both, so it
cannot detect the discrepancy it exists to catch.
E2 · Bounds do not describe the mesh
SM_Dadongmen_LOD0 asset bounds are an 18.5 cm-thick slab
(2000 × 18.5 × 2100) while get_actor_bounds on the spawned
Blueprint reports 3800 × 3120.8 × 2248. Neither matches the
other, so the "height" the validator asserts on is not the real
building height. Still under investigation when observation ended.
E3 · Component count double-reported
k2_gather_subobject_data_for_blueprint returns each component
O1–O4 · Operational hygiene
Second UnrealEditor-Cmd opened against the same project while
the interactive editor was live. Validation's new_blank_map left
unsaved Untitled maps until the tuning guard aborted on /Temp/
Untitled_21. Resume guard is non-idempotent.
Outcome of the observed run
All four gates imported as independent Blueprints, tuned, rendered
front/rear/close, and archived with records + diagrams. Editor and
commandlet validation both report PASS on the final state. No commit
was made; 119 files untracked; 2 tracked files modified.
